companyFieldUpdates.description: Vopak Industrial Infrastructure Americas, LLC is a contracted industrial-terminal and bulk-liquid-storage platform on the U.S. Gulf Coast. Its Freeport, St. Charles and Plaquemine sites provide tank storage and marine, pipeline, rail and truck logistics under long-term service agreements, with Dow as the disclosed anchor customer. Royal Vopak and BlackRock's Global Energy & Power Infrastructure Fund III formed the 50/50 joint venture and completed the $620 million acquisition of the three terminals from Dow on December 2, 2020. The terminals are nested operating sites beneath one VIIA PortCo. BlackRock's October 2024 acquisition of GIP did not create a separate VIIA ownership period, and no later sale or signed pending ownership transfer was found through August 23, 2026.
